summary: Mercedes hunts another straight-line advantage over Ferrari's upgraded engine as Lewis Hamilton seeks to extend his dominance at Monza's high-speed layout. Red Bull faces a driver shortage with Isack Hadjar sidelined by wrist injury, potentially reshuffling the midfield order and tactical opportunities for rival teams. A dominant performance here could prove decisive in the championship fight, with Mercedes threatening to build an insurmountable lead before the season's closing rounds.
